route: catalog.archives.gov public IIIF Image API v3 (no key needed): item page discovered via the site's own React search UI (headless Chromium, tools/browser_fetch.js; plain curl to catalog.archives.gov/search or /proxy/records/search returns only the app shell), image URLs read from the item page's embedded IIIF manifest data.
